##### Project general facts

Solvyn City is an ambitious mixed-use coastal development, designed as an entirely new lifestyle destination overlooking the Indian Ocean. Spanning more than 30,000 sq.m, the project combines a collection of apartments and villas with panoramic ocean views, creating a self-contained residential and hospitality ecosystem. The master plan includes 81 apartments and 58 villas, complemented by extensive commercial and lifestyle infrastructure. Inspired by resort-style living, Solvyn City integrates architectural aesthetics, wellness-oriented spaces, and immersive public environments, establishing a new benchmark for luxury coastal communities in Bali.

The development offers an exceptional range of amenities designed around wellness, leisure, and social experiences. Residents will have access to a private artificial surfing wave,wellness and longevity center, a large swimming pool with sun loungers, yoga facilities, biohacking and preventive health programs, coworking spaces, concierge services, children's play areas, cafés, bars, and restaurants. A signature art bridge integrated with interactive installations creates a unique open-air gallery experience, while a rooftop cinema and dedicated wedding and event venue transform the project into a vibrant destination for both residents and visitors. These carefully curated amenities create a lifestyle focused on well-being, entertainment, and community engagement.

The residences are designed to reflect the project's premium positioning, combining contemporary architecture with elegant interiors and panoramic ocean views. The brochure emphasizes high standards of comfort, sophisticated design, and luxury resort-style living throughout the development. While specific interior finishing specifications are not provided, the residences are presented as premium homes featuring high-quality contemporary finishes and carefully selected materials that complement the project's upscale character. Information regarding furniture packages, kitchen appliances, and branded interior equipment is not specified in the brochure.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on the Bukit Peninsula within Badung regency, this exceptional location places residents in Bali's most premium area, confirmed by high demand, top beaches, and the highest concentration of luxury hotels. The Bukit is home to the majority of the island's five-star properties, including legendary names such as Bulgari, Raffles, Jumeirah, Kempinski, Four Seasons, and Ayana. Its beaches rank among the most popular in the world, hosting permanent world surfing championship events that attract global attention.

The location is distinguished by its unmatched natural beauty and strategic convenience. Just a short drive from Ngurah Rai International Airport, the area offers easy transit while maintaining privacy, calm, and silence, free from traffic congestion and noisy bar streets. The cliff-top sunsets over the Indian Ocean are spectacular and unmatched anywhere else in Bali. The surrounding landscape features vast natural expanses, creating a peaceful and serene environment.

For those seeking a residence that embodies prestige, natural beauty, and strong investment fundamentals, the Bukit Peninsula delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class beaches, luxury hospitality, and growing international demand makes it one of Bali's most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, serene, exclusive and effortlessly inspiring.
